author: olpipi
title: Windows Debug build fails: MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async conflicting return type
signature: conflicting return type specified for virtual hint_prefetch_async override|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build (Windows Debug, MSVC) fails compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp: C2555 overriding virtual function return type differs and is not covariant

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_windows_debug
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the Build / Build job failed

key_errors: src\core\tests\ov_tensor_test.cpp(1370): error C2555: 'ov::test::`anonymous-namespace'::MockMappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async': overriding virtual function return type differs and is not covariant from 'ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async'
root_cause: PR #38993 changed the pure-virtual method ov::MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async in src/common/util/include/openvino/util/mmap_object.hpp from returning void to returning util::PrefetchToken (noexcept), as part of introducing the PrefetchScheduler feature. The PR updated the MockMappedMemory test double in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp to match the new signature, but missed the separate, pre-existing MockMappedMemory mock in the anonymous namespace of src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (not in the PR's changed-files list), which still declares MOCK_METHOD(void, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t, size_t), (override)) with no noexcept. On MSVC this mismatch is reported as C2555 (return type not covariant); the same root cause was already reported for the Linux RISC-V/GCC toolchain earlier in this run series as 'conflicting return type specified for virtual hint_prefetch_async override', confirming this is a deterministic, toolchain-independent compile error that reproduces on every platform building ov_core_unit_tests.
reproduction_steps: Configure and build ov_core_unit_tests on Windows with MSVC, e.g.: cmake -G Ninja -DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target ov_core_unit_tests. The error reproduces on any platform/toolchain compiling src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp against the updated mmap_object.hpp interface (already confirmed on Linux RISC-V/GCC as well).
recommended_actions: Update the MOCK_METHOD declaration for hint_prefetch_async in src/core/tests/ov_tensor_test.cpp (around line 1370) to MOCK_METHOD(ov::util::PrefetchToken, hint_prefetch_async, (size_t offset, size_t size), (noexcept, override)) to match the new interface signature in mmap_object.hpp:85, mirroring the already-correct mock in src/core/tests/shared_buffer.cpp.
Grep the whole tree for any other MOCK_METHOD/hand-written overrides of MappedMemory::hint_prefetch_async that may need the same signature update.
Re-run the full unit test build locally (both GCC and MSVC if possible) with -Werror before pushing to catch similar interface/mock mismatches early.
prevention_strategies: When changing a pure-virtual method's signature (return type, parameters, or noexcept-ness) in a public interface header, grep the whole tree for MOCK_METHOD/MOCK_CONST_METHOD declarations and hand-written overrides of that method and update all of them in the same commit, not just the ones referenced by the PR's own changed-files list. Add a CI/pre-commit grep check that flags mock declarations whose signature no longer matches the interface they implement.
historical_context: This is a recurrence of signature_hash 4178da568a100f35, first recorded ~16 minutes earlier in run 41095713725 (Linux RISC-V, Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10) for the same PR #38993 and the same underlying root cause (stale MockMappedMemory override in ov_tensor_test.cpp), now surfacing on a second toolchain (MSVC, Windows Debug) as it builds the same test file. Pattern count incremented to 2.
